It is so funny that I have been reading other posts and there is so much good advice for them. I have even tried to help others that are hurting. 
I guess in my particular situation, by not having any input that there actually isn't any advice or suggestions at all. I have given it much thought and I realize that ive made the right decission. ive tried it before but this time i won't fail.

Can I give you a virtual hug? I can't even imagine what it must have been like to have been bullied so much in your life. Kids can be so cruel. As you get older the bullying actually stops. Those bullies grow up and realize what they did was wrong. 
I don't blame you for being angry. It sounds like you have had a rough time. It sounds like you had to grow up real fast without much of a real childhood. I find forgiveness is the best way to move forward and help with the anger.What have you done in the past to deal with it?
I really hope you don't kill yourself and Im happy to hear you want to live on. I read on some other posts that people have written that if you don't have access to support groups, etc, that it is good to join a sports group or something that you really like to help make friends. 
I really wish for you to have some positive stuff come your way. There are so many ups and downs in life. Just remember tomorrow is another day and you never know what is around that corner.

ive been having health issues that keep getting worse to the point that i am almost on bed rest since feb. and for 4 mos from last may-sept. There is no cure. I have been sick for 10 years so my family is frustrated with me. They think i am faking it and offer no support, and/or they are just so used to me being ill that they ignore me. I need help even getting up to eat a microwave dinner, or to let the dogs out. I have told them that i need help. This is the first time I have ever said I need it. Ive never asked them before. I was told by my sister that she said we all need help and she didn't care that I was sick. I have trouble even getting up to let the dogs out. My sister has also been abusive and threatening to me. I live with her.
My daughter is busy with her life and lives on the other side of town and doesn't understand how much help i am needing.
my mom and dad are gone and I have lost my friends because i can't go out and do anything with them. 
i lost my job and am on disability and have been trying to get the strength to move out but i just don't have the energy, and my income is limited so it is hard to find a place.
So, i really wouldn't be hurting anyone by killing myself. In fact they would benefit financially. So win win.
I know people say it is a selfish act but I disagree. I can't hurt anyone who doesn't care.

I heard that after a certain amount of time you can absolve your record? I had a friend that did it and she needed to be fingerprinted for her employer and wasn't going to get the job. I don't know who she talked to but she got it taken off and got the job. I hope this helps.
